functions.name: entry_gate
functions.notes: stamp-noop word0 0x0000daad (render addi imm; build-id class, arc A); entry=+4 (040 s3 convention, executable from 0x4). Prologue: csr.r r3,csr0xbc @0x4 (ROM return addr; i2b entry idiom); CRC gate: call crc16_block @0x28 over 7 words @RAM 0x000e68a0 (ptr built @0x18-0x1c set2 0xe/set3 0x68a0), expected 0x9a2f (ld.i @0x14; ld.i render is low 16 of imm20, scripts/irisc/README.md:190) compared @0x30-0x34 (subs+b.f.cc0); mismatch -> epilogue 0x68-0x74 ret.r to CSR 0xbc value (return to ROM, rest of body not executed from this path). Match -> status CSR 0x228 <- r23|2 (0x9a2a-class) @0x50-0x54; dead bit-poll @0x58-0x5c (b.bset on constant); tail @0x60-0x64 r4=0xffffff00 (addi -0x100), ret.r zero,r8,r4 -> jump to r4 value (slaspec ret.r = goto [RTlosrc], scripts/irisc/iRISC.slaspec:738; task-04 canon fix: r8 is not added) - ROM continuation / reset candidate [H]. Static fall-through 0x48-0x4c (call event_report_slotcopy) exists only if b.f @0x44 not taken; with cc0 semantics on constant 0x9a29-2 it is always taken (wrinkle, journal s0). Same bytes in 0751 except stamp and call target @0x4c.

functions.name: main_halt
functions.notes: 0x204-0x21c. ROM-entry candidate #2 (no direct callers in body; sits right after zero table 0x78-0x204, 117 zero words = runtime-filled data). Flow: call 0x1a0c @0x204, call 0x19b4 (r4=r1 stack) @0x20c, call 0x510 @0x214, call 0x1434 @0x218, then jump 0x21c to self @0x21c = HALT (the only self-jump in the body). Structural twin in 0751 @0x204 with version-specific call targets (0x19b8/0x1960/0x510/0x1434).

functions.name: crc16_block
functions.notes: 0x220-0x298. CRC16 over N words at ptr r4 (loop @0x260-0x274, b.f.cc0 while r22!=0), seed r4=0x000effff (set3 0xffff over hi 0xe @0x248), result stored to [r5] @0x27c. Same poly/final as container CRC (crc16_mlx, arc A) but runs on a RAM block, not on the container. Identical in 0751 @0x220 (0751 also carries a byte-identical duplicate copy @0x2464, not annotated separately).

functions.name: crc16_step
functions.notes: 0x298-0x2c8. Bitwise CRC16 step: 32 iterations (addi r6,0x20 @0x298, loop @0x29c-0x2c0), poly 0x100b (xor @0x2ac), 64-bit shift concat (shl64.i/shr/or @0x29c-0x2a4), b.bclr 15 on msb @0x2a8. ret.d @0x2c4.

functions.name: crc16_final
functions.notes: 0x2c8-0x2f8. CRC16 final: 16 residual rounds (loop @0x2cc-0x2ec), poly xor @0x2e0, inversion xor r4,r4,0x-1 @0x2f0, ret.d @0x2f4. Range includes internal loop label 0x2e4 (jump @0x2dc).

functions.name: config_pairs_102_104
functions.notes: 0x2f8-0x33c. Config applier via (CSR 0x28 selector, data CSR 0x102/0x103/0x104) pairs: (0x60->0x103) @0x2f8-0x304, (0x1d0,0x7ff->0x103) @0x308-0x314, (0x1c0,0->0x104) @0x318-0x324, (0x18,0x100->0x102) @0x328-0x334. Not boot_record CR-init records (no 0x30d0xxxx/0x0c1xxxxx class values) - internal CSR-space config.

functions.name: map_one
functions.notes: 0x430-0x4a0. Mapping helper, 8 call sites (most-called function). Consumes (attrs<<48 | addr, size) pairs from map_regions.

functions.name: map_regions
functions.notes: 0xbfc-0xcb4. Memory layout via map_one calls @0xc18-0xc9c with attr 0x8111 and section bases baked as constants (identical addresses in 0751): 0x207d0000/0x580 @0xc1c, 0x2052ff40 (ITOC sec 0x02 load)/0x1403 @0xc30, 0xff800000/0x80 @0xc44, 0x2b0000/0x400 @0xc50 (dest region of the 0x40B slot copy), 0x20710000 (IRON_PREP 0x05 load)/0x800 @0xc64, 0x20740000 (sec 0x06)/0x400 @0xc78, 0x20780000 (sec 0x04)/0x800 @0xc8c. Bases == ITOC param0 (mlxfwutil, this task) - toc-derived data baked at build time, not a runtime ITOC walk. Alt path call 0x4608 @0xca4 when arg==0 (subsi @0xc08).

functions.name: dev_enc_init
functions.notes: 0x1258-0x1434. Copies 0xc bytes RAM 0x000f0d84 -> 0xe3afc @0x127c-0x128c; zeroes 0xe3b08..0xe3b7c @0x129c-0x12a4; flash-read 0xc bytes via flash_read_cmd @0x12c8 (r5=0xc, r7=r8=r9=r10=1); copies 0x34 bytes 0xe3b00 -> 0xe3b08 @0x12f0-0x1300; writes ASCII tags: CSR 0x6c0 <- 1 @0x1308, CSR 0x6c1 <- 0x4445562d 'DEV-' @0x130c-0x1314, CSR 0x6c2 <- 0x454e4300 'ENC\0' @0x1318-0x1320. Second flash-read @0x1390. Same address range in 0751 (common target).

functions.name: error_report
functions.notes: 0x24c4-0x2590. Error/status reporter; called with negative codes (e.g. -0x64=-100 from memcmp_verify fail path @0x2f24-0x2f28) from 6 sites in 0800: 0x158c, 0x15e8, 0x16dc, 0x2f28, 0x2fb8, 0x33dc. 0751 twin @0x1dcc (5 sites).

functions.name: hw_cmd
functions.notes: 0x27a0-0x27c4. HW-engine command submit: CSR 0x220 <- (arg<<19)|0x6000 @0x27a8-0x27b0 (shl64.i 0x13 + set2 0x6000); dead poll idioms on constant 0x9a20 @0x27a0-0x27a4/0x27b4-0x27b8 (b.bset 30). 0751 twin @0x2060.

functions.name: hw_cmd_seq
functions.notes: 0x283c-0x2914. Issues 0xc482-counted command series via hw_cmd (@0x2894, step r20+=2 @0x28c8), collects results into a buffer (lw.r/st.d! loop @0x28a4-0x28b4); early-exit when result matches target (mask32 r6,r5,0x10,8 @0x28bc, subs/b.t.cc0 @0x28c0-0x28c4); returns collected word or -1. Candidate interface of the HW verifier engine (boot2 itself has no SW-SHA, task-02 s4). 0751 twin @0x20fc.

functions.name: event_report_slotcopy
functions.notes: 0x2914-0x29e4. 1) call hw_cmd_seq @0x2934; result==-1 -> fatal: 0xdeadbeaf -> CSR 0x5df @0x29bc-0x29c4 (abort path). 2) event-log loop @0x2954-0x2984 (count from mask32 field of 0xc483, entries to RAM 0x6bbe0>>3=0xd77c region, stride 0x20). 3) CSR 0x22b <- 0xd77c @0x2988-0x298c. 4) gate arg==0xa6 (subsi @0x2990) -> copy 0x40 bytes (16 words, slot-size of hashes-table, arc A task-05) [arg] -> RAM 0x2b1328 @0x2998-0x29b8 - hashes_table consumer candidate [H]. 0751 twin @0x21d4 byte-identical except inner call targets and copy dest 0x2b1324.

functions.name: memcmp_verify
functions.notes: 0x2dac-0x2f40 (head called from 0x31e4; internal labels 0x2df4/0x2e40/0x2e8c are jump targets, 0x2e8c is NOT a function start). Read+compare verifier: entry dispatcher 0x2dac-0x2e88 (op0x36 predicate on arg class @0x2de0-0x2de4, ld.b [r23] compare @0x2e58-0x2e60); default early-exit path flash-read via flash_read_cmd @0x2e6c-0x2e80 (args r7=1,r8=0,r10=1) -> jump epilogue 0x2f2c; compare path from 0x2e8c: r5=max(arg,0x40) @0x2e8c-0x2e98, 0x40 (slot-size of hashes-table, arc A task-05) flash-read @0x2eb8, ld.b [r23] @0x2ebc; decoy compare 0xdeadbeaf vs 0x35df @0x2ec4-0x2ed8 (never equal, falls through); reference memcmp loop [r4+i*4] vs [RAM 0x000e3b00+i*4] @0x2efc-0x2f1c (count from mask32 field of 0xc483), mismatch -> r4=-0x64 -> call error_report @0x2f24-0x2f28 (abort/report path); epilogue label 0x2f2c, ret @0x2f3c. 0751 twin @0x2660 (8/8, called from 0x2a94; flash reads @0x2734/0x276c).

functions.name: flash_read_cmd
functions.notes: 0x4720-0x4778. Flash/block read via CSR 0x6e0 command class: len>>6 -> CSR 0x6e5 @0x4720-0x4724, selector CSR 0x28 <- 0 @0x472c, args -> CSR 0x6e6/0x6e7 @0x4730-0x4734, command (r6<<16|r7<<14)|0xc0100000 -> CSR 0x6e0 @0x474c-0x475c, clear 0x6e0 @0x4770; dead poll idioms on constant 0x8ee0 @0x4740-0x4748/0x4760-0x4764. Callers: 0x12c8, 0x1390 (dev_enc_init), 0x2e80, 0x2eb8 (memcmp_verify). 0751 twin @0x405c.

functions.name: entry_gate
functions.notes: Same prologue as 0800 except stamp word0 0x00007503 and call target @0x4c (0x21d4 vs 0x2914). CRC gate over 7 words @RAM 0x000e68a0 vs 0x9a2f @0x28-0x34; status CSR 0x228 @0x54; tail jump-to-r4 (0xffffff00, slaspec ret.r = goto [RTlosrc]) @0x60-0x64. See 0800 entry_gate notes for the word-by-word structure (shared).

functions.name: main_halt
functions.notes: 0x204-0x21c. Structural twin of 0800 main_halt at the same address: call 0x19b8 @0x204, call 0x1960 (r4=r1) @0x20c, call 0x510 @0x214, call 0x1434 @0x218, HALT self-jump @0x21c (only self-jump in body).

functions.name: crc16_block
functions.notes: 0x220-0x298. Byte-identical to 0800 (same address; verified word-for-word). 0751-only call target 0x2464 shares the 8-word prologue but is a DIFFERENT function (diverges @0x2484: 0x20-stride walk, call 0x1eb4 @0x24a0) - not a CRC duplicate (prefix-match over-claim corrected in task-03 fix).

functions.name: crc16_step
functions.notes: 0x298-0x2c8. Byte-identical to 0800 (same address). See 0800 notes.

functions.name: crc16_final
functions.notes: 0x2c8-0x2f8. Byte-identical to 0800 (same address).

functions.name: config_pairs_102_104
functions.notes: 0x2f8-0x33c. Byte-identical to 0800 (same address); see 0800 notes.

functions.name: map_one
functions.notes: 0x430-0x4a0. Same address as 0800; mapping helper.

functions.name: map_regions
functions.notes: 0xbfc-0xcb4. Same address and same section-base constants as 0800 (xref sites 0xc1c/0xc30/0xc64/0xc78/0xc8c identical); see 0800 notes.

functions.name: dev_enc_init
functions.notes: 0x1258-0x1434. Same address as 0800; flash reads @0x12c8/0x1390; 'DEV-'/'ENC' tags -> CSR 0x6c0-0x6c2.

functions.name: error_report
functions.notes: 0x1dcc-0x1e70. Twin of 0800 error_report @0x24c4 (prologue 7/8); 5 call sites in 0751: 0x158c, 0x15f8, 0x27dc, 0x286c, 0x2c8c.

functions.name: hw_cmd_seq
functions.notes: 0x20fc-0x21d4. Twin of 0800 hw_cmd_seq @0x283c (8/8); 0xc482-counted command series.

functions.name: event_report_slotcopy
functions.notes: 0x21d4-0x22a4. Byte-identical to 0800 @0x2914 except inner call targets (0x20fc/0x2060) and copy dest 0x2b1324 (vs 0x2b1328): fatal 0xdeadbeaf -> CSR 0x5df @0x227c-0x2284; CSR 0x22b <- 0xd77c @0x2248-0x224c; gate arg==0xa6 -> 0x40B copy [arg] -> 0x2b1324 @0x2258-0x2278 (hashes_table consumer candidate [H]).

functions.name: memcmp_verify
functions.notes: 0x2660-0x27f4. Twin of 0800 memcmp_verify @0x2dac (8/8; called from 0x2a94 vs 0x31e4): default early-exit flash-read @0x2734, compare path 0x40-slot flash-read @0x276c, reference memcmp loop vs [RAM 0x000e3b00+i*4] @0x27b0-0x27d0, mismatch -> r4=-0x64 -> call error_report @0x27dc-0x27e0 (abort/report path), epilogue label 0x27e0, ret.r @0x27f0.

functions.name: flash_read_cmd
functions.notes: 0x405c-0x40b4. Twin of 0800 flash_read_cmd @0x4720 (8/8). Flash/block read via CSR 0x6e0 command class: len>>6 -> CSR 0x6e5 @0x405c-0x4060, selector CSR 0x28 <- 0 @0x4068, args -> CSR 0x6e6/0x6e7 @0x406c-0x4070, command (r6<<16|r7<<14)|0xc0100000 -> CSR 0x6e0 @0x4088-0x4098, dead poll idioms on constant 0x8ee0 @0x407c-0x4084/0x409c-0x40a0, clear 0x6e0 @0x40ac, ret.d @0x40b0. Callers: 0x12c8, 0x1390 (dev_enc_init), 0x2734, 0x276c (memcmp_verify).

functions.name: entry_halt
functions.notes: Dispatcher (040 s3 pattern): call 0x20500938 (stack_init) @0x20500044, push zero @0x20500048, call 0x205002ac (main_loader) @0x2050004c, self-jump HALT @0x20500050 (jump 0x20500050). word0 @0x20500040 = 00000000 stamp-noop, entry=load+4 = ITOC param1. Reached only if main_loader returns normally; both main exits are computed jumps to ROM.

functions.name: delay_status
functions.notes: Delay+report helper, no direct callers in body - referenced as DATA: function pointer stored to main_loader descriptor table @0x20500614 (addi 0x54 + addi.hi 0x2050). Two spin loops (ld.i 0x831c / 0x821c, subsi 0x-1 back-branch b.t.0x1), CSR 0x200 <- r7 via r4=-0x100 @0x20500060-0x20500064 (same idiom as boot2 entry_gate tail), ret.d @0x20500074. Byte-identical in 0751 @0x20500054.

functions.name: csr_config_init
functions.notes: CSR config via (0x28 selector, data) pairs: CSR 0x20c <- 0x8000 @0x2050007c-0x20500084, RAM-window arithmetic (mask 0x7ffffffc, +0xc800) @0x20500088-0x205000a4. Function pointer in main_loader table @0x205005bc (addi 0x78 + addi.hi 0x2050). ret.d @0x205000c0. Same address in 0751.

functions.name: stream_verify
functions.notes: LIVE PATH of 0800 main (gate below): streaming image verifier. CSR 0x411 <- -0x801 (stage start) @0x20500100-0x20500104; r21 = size_get @0x20500108; -1 -> fail. Loop @0x2050012c-0x20501cc: at every 0x10000 boundary poll hw engine (0x20502e08) and reset address (0x20502e50, addr=r18+len) @0x20500134-0x2050014c; chunk len min(rem,0x100) @0x20500168-0x20500174; block_read(src, len>>4, sp+0x148, 2) @0x20500184 (flash chunk); chunk_process(buf, sp+8 ctx, len, off) @0x20500198 - result != 0 -> return 1 (fail); progress CSR 0x71b @0x205001b8-0x20501c0; loop while r18 < size. Tail call 0x205054f4 (verify_final) @0x205001d8, r5=r23 arg. Called only from main_loader early block @0x20500350 (0x205000c4 is 0800-only; in 0751 this address is main_loader itself).

functions.name: post_verify_report
functions.notes: Post-verify-success step (called @0x20500378 after CSR 0x411 <- -0x802): ptr 0x205066e0 (16B const block 0x90 before H512 header 0x20506770) built @0x20500248-0x2050024c (addi 0x66e0 + addi.hi 0x2050); call 0x2050627c (sp+0x10, 0x205066e0, 0x10) @0x2050025c - copy/compare 16 bytes; reporter 0x20502aec x2 @0x2050026c/0x20500290; hw poll @0x20500274-0x20500284. 0800-only (no 0751 twin: verifier path absent there).

functions.name: main_loader
functions.notes: 0800 main, 419 w. Prologue CSR 0xbc -> [sp+4], frame 0x860, r23=ld.i 0xc800 (RDlo: low half only, full imm20 render lossy). Debug gate CSR 0x6d4 @0x205002e8-0x205002fc (skipped: b.f.0x0 on constant). GATE @0x20500300-0x20500304: ld.i r4,0xc481; b.bclr 0,r4 -> 0x20500388 - bit0 of 0x?c481 is 1, branch NOT taken -> live path = early block 0x20500308-0x20500384: op0x36 recount loop, call stream_verify @0x20500350, r4==0 -> CSR 0x411 <- -0x802 + call post_verify_report @0x20500378, else -0x804; exit CSR 0x0 <- -0x100 + ret.r r4 (jump to r4 value, slaspec ret.r = goto [RTlosrc]) @0x2050037c-0x20500384. Body 0x20500388+ (taken only if bit0=0 - static-dead from this entry; byte-twin of 0751 main_loader at -0x270): stack clear, call 0x2050165c @0x205003a4 + table_check(0x20501958) @0x205003b0 (err -0x1e -> error_report), CSR 0x12a/0x12b config (skipped: b.bclr 1 on 0xaa4), call 0x2050159c @0x20500414 + table_check (err -0x1f), MTCF scan loop 0x20500434-0x20500494 (magic 0x4d544346, entry field +0x14 masked 0x7ffffffc, block_read 1 word, match -> CSR 0x244 <- addr @0x20500488), RAM descriptor table build 0x20500498-0x205006dc (ptrs 0x2b5000/0x2b5110/0x2b3d80/0x2b5900/0x2b3980, RAM 0x000e0800/0x000e0c00, fn ptrs 0x20500054/0x20500078/0x20500934, 0x20503008, 0x20501eb4, 0x20502008-class ptr for 0751), 2-pass walk 0x205007c0-0x205008ac (handlers 0x20501bd4 pass2 / 0x20501fe4 pass1, stride 0x28, CSR 0x10 <- r17+0x8001 per entry @0x205007c8-0x205007cc), final call hw_cmd_500(0x33ffff,0,1,7) @0x205008d4, exit: read ptr chain + CSR 0x0 (csr.r) then ret.r r4 @0x205008e4-0x205008e8 (jump to CSR 0x0 value); normal epilogue ret.r r3 (ROM return) @0x20500930.

functions.name: stack_init
functions.notes: r1 = 0x207d1ff8 + (CSR 0x4 field << 13): csr.r r4,csr0x4 @0x20500938, mask32 r4,r4,0x9,4, set2/set3 0x207d1ff8, shl64.i 0xd, add @0x2050093c-0x20500950. Per-CPU stack top in boot2-mapped RAM region 0x207d0000 (boot2 map_regions). ret.d @0x20500954. Twin 0751 @0x205006c4; same code in IRON_PREP @0x20710c60.

functions.name: error_report
functions.notes: Error/status reporter: CSR 0xb8 <- code @0x20501404, CSR 0x411 <- r23 @0x20501408, call 0x20500958 (delay frame) @0x2050140c, CSR 0x400/0x484 pair for codes < -0x800 @0x20501418-0x20501424, spins. Callers: 0x205003c0, 0x20500430 (main_loader), 0x20501e9c, 0x2050205c (walk_handler), 0x20502480. Twin 0751 @0x20500ad8 (callers 0x20500150, 0x205001c0, 0x20501634, ...).

functions.name: hw_crc16_setup
functions.notes: HW CRC16 engine programmer: CSR 0x69b <- 1 (enable?) @0x20501560, CSR 0x698/0x69c config, poly write CSR 0x699. ITOC-entry CRC class = poly 0x100b (same family as boot2 crc16_step / container crc16_mlx, arc A) - BOOT3 uses the HW engine instead of SW loop. Twin 0751 @0x20501720 (poly site 0x20501724).

functions.name: table_check
functions.notes: Entry-table validator (called 2x from main_loader @0x205003b0/0x20500420 with 0x400B buffers built by 0x2050165c/0x2050159c): arg==-1 -> -1; count = 0xc483 & 0xff (mask32-field idiom, same as boot2) @0x205019a0-0x205019a8; walks 0x20-stride entries, ITOC magic pair check 0x2342cafa/0xbacafe00 at @0x20501600/0x20501614 lives in the 0x2050165c builder - see consumes.toc_ptr. Internal labels 0x205019d0/0x20501aec are jump targets. Twin 0751 @0x20500ff4 (byte-same logic, mask sites 0x20501030/0x2050105c).

functions.name: itoc_parse
functions.notes: ITOC structure parser: ITOC_HDR magic words 0x2342cafa/0xbacafe00 built set2/set3 @0x20501c48-0x20501c54, section tags 'mDev' 0x6d446576 @0x20501c38, 'Info' 0x496e666f @0x20501c40; op0x36 predicate dispatch @0x20501bec; 0x20-stride entry walk (r4 += 0x20). The ITOC walker of the chain (0751-live; in 0800 static-dead from main entry - reached only if ROM calls it directly, offline-invisible). Twin 0751 @0x205011b4 (magic sites 0x20501218-0x20501234); 0800 also has magic pair inside crypto region @0x20504298-0x205042a4 (fn 0x20504154, called from verify path 0x20505124/0x20505184).

functions.name: walk_handler
functions.notes: Walk pass-1 entry handler (called from main_loader loop @0x20500818 with r4=r23 0xc800-class, r5=entry, r6=table, r7=0): dispatches per entry type byte [r6], calls itoc_parse @0x20502030, delay/poll fn 0x205014fc @0x20502410, error -1 -> CSR 0x10 write + error_report @0x2050205c. Twin 0751 @0x205015bc (calls itoc_parse 0x205011b4 @0x20501608, error_report -0x46 @0x20501634).

functions.name: block_read
functions.notes: Block/flash read via CSR 0x28 selector + 0x120/0x128 window pair + CSR 0x110/0x111/0x113/0x114/0x118 config cluster (15/5/3/3/2 sites); 6 call sites (0x20500184 stream_verify, 0x20500478 main MTCF scan, 0x205015d0, 0x205016d8 builders, 0x20501a30, 0x20501b78). Most-called section fn. Twin 0751 @0x20501d58 (CSR 0x100/0x108/0x110 cluster; 0x1000-step address build @0x20501f74-0x20501f88).

functions.name: hw_cmd_500
functions.notes: HW command via CSR 0x500: spin (ld.i 0x8d00) @0x205031b8-0x205031c0, CSR 0x51f <- r5, command (r4<<6)|(r5<<27)|(r7<<24)|0xc0000000 -> CSR 0x500 @0x205031c8-0x205031e0, clear 0x500 @0x205031ec, ret.d @0x205031f0. Called at main_loader tail (0x205008d4) with (0x33ffff,0,1,7) - load/trigger class of the walk finish. Twin 0751 @0x205021b8 (call site 0x20500660).

functions.name: flash_read_cmd
functions.notes: Flash read via CSR 0x6e5/0x6e6/0x6e7/0x6e0 command class - byte-twin of boot2 flash_read_cmd: len>>6 -> CSR 0x6e5 @0x205031f4-0x205031f8, selector CSR 0x28 <- 0 @0x20503200, args -> 0x6e7/0x6e6 @0x20503204-0x20503208, command (r7<<14)|(r6<<16)|0xc0100000 -> CSR 0x6e0 @0x20503220-0x20503230, clear @0x20503244, ret.d @0x20503248. Callers 0x20501df4/0x20501e2c. Twin 0751 @0x2050226c (callers 0x205013d0/0x20501408).

functions.name: chunk_process
functions.notes: Per-chunk processor of stream_verify (call site 0x20500198): call 0x2050500c family -> 0x20503f08 -> sha512_init(0x205058c8) and the 0x205058f8 update driver - hashes the 0x100B flash chunk into ctx sp+8; progress counters at sp+0x7c/0x80 @0x2050506c-0x20505090; mid-entry 0x2050508c is a called label (from 0x20503074) - shared-tail entry, not a separate function.
